products.name: PRINCE® MAXX GOLD 4T SAE 5W-40
facts: P-10 Ester-Based Fully Synthetic Engine Oil
description: PRINCE® MAXX GOLD 4T SAE 5W-40 is an advanced fully synthetic four-stroke motorcycle engine oil that synergistically combines severely hydroisomerized, high-purity synthetic base oils with proprietary P-10 Ester-Based Technology and a state-of-the-art additive system to deliver exceptionally stable lubrication performance, mechanical wear protection and powertrain efficiency. Its superior low-volatility, high-polarity ester chemistry enhances lubricating film adhesion to critical metallic surfaces, providing exceptional protection against friction, wear and thermal-related degradation under sustained high-RPM, full-load operation. Engineered to address the simultaneous lubrication demands of the engine, transmission and wet clutch assembly, its highly shear-stable formulation promotes precise gear shifting, controlled clutch engagement and consistent power transfer, while maintaining superior piston cleanliness, oxidation resistance and viscosity integrity under extreme operating conditions.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Developed for a wide range of modern four-stroke motorcycles, from everyday commuter and street motorcycles to powerful high-performance motorcycles, including those equipped with integrated transmissions and wet clutch assemblies. Suitable for daily commuting, urban riding, long-distance touring, spirited riding and demanding high-performance applications where SAE 5W-40 viscosity and the applicable performance specifications are recommended by the manufacturer.

products.name: PRINCE® MAXX-SHIFT GL-5 SAE 75W-90 4T

Its robust lubricating film strength provides superior protection against gear tooth scuffing, pitting and premature abrasive wear under intense mechanical loads and high-torque riding conditions. Engineered with exceptional shear stability and thermal-oxidative resistance, its advanced formulation maintains excellent viscosity behaviour under very demanding operating temperatures, while excellent low-temperature fluidity promotes rapid lubricant circulation and minimizes drivetrain frictional losses.

sections.label: Intended Applications

products.name: PRINCE® MAXX-SHIFT GL-4 SAE 10W-30

Its optimized frictional characteristics promote smooth gear shifting and positive clutch engagement, while excellent shear stability ensures reliable gear protection under demanding riding conditions.

products.name: PRINCE® MAXX SCOOTER GEAR OIL SAE 80W-90

Its cutting-edge formulation is developed to maintain effective lubrication under concentrated mechanical loads, minimize gear meshing noise and resist oil degradation caused by thermal buildup, promoting efficient power transfer from the transmission to the rear wheel.

sections.label: Intended Applications

products.name: PRINCE® FORK OIL 5W LIGHT

Its low-viscosity characteristics facilitate rapid fluid flow through damping valves, enhancing suspension sensitivity and responsiveness to minor road irregularities. Cutting-edge anti-foam and friction-modifying technology minimizes aeration and initial fork stiction, while a high viscosity index promotes consistent damping performance across varying operating temperatures.

sections.text: Developed for conventional telescopic forks, upside-down (USD) forks and advanced cartridge-type front suspension systems requiring light-viscosity fork fluids. Particularly suitable for modern sports motorcycles, motocross, enduro and high-performance road motorcycles where precise compression and rebound damping, rapid suspension response and enhanced handling sensitivity are essential, subject to the suspension manufacturer's viscosity recommendations.

products.name: PRINCE® FORK OIL 10W MODERATE

products.name: PRINCE® BRAKE & CLUTCH FLUID DOT 4
facts: FMVSS 116 DOT 4, ISO 4925 Class 4, SAE J1704
description: PRINCE® BRAKE & CLUTCH FLUID DOT 4 is a high-performance brake fluid formulated with glycol ethers and borate esters to deliver excellent thermal stability, consistent hydraulic pressure transmission and reliable braking performance under demanding operating conditions. Its enhanced viscosity characteristics support responsive brake actuation and effective hydraulic pressure modulation in modern braking systems and compatible Anti-lock Braking Systems (ABS). Featuring a Dry Equilibrium Reflux Boiling Point (ERBP) exceeding 240°C and a Wet ERBP exceeding 160°C, it helps minimise vapour lock and retain uncompromising braking efficiency during repeated braking cycles.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Applicable in hydraulic disc and drum braking systems in motorcycles and other powersports vehicles, including those equipped with Anti-lock Braking Systems (ABS) and Combined Braking Systems (CBS). Also suitable for hydraulic clutch systems where DOT 4 brake fluid is required by the manufacturer.

products.name: PRINCE® MAXX COOL SPORT −37°C YELLOW
description: PRINCE® MAXX COOL SPORT −37°C YELLOW is a high-performance, prediluted, ready-to-use two-wheeler coolant expertly formulated with Hybrid Organic Acid Technology (HOAT) to meet the demanding thermal management requirements of modern and powerful water-cooled motorcycle engines. Its nitrite-free, borate-free and amine-free formulation delivers comprehensive corrosion protection for lightweight aluminium alloys, while minimizing localized boiling, cavitation, scale and harmful deposit formation. Engineered for efficient heat transfer and consistent thermal stability, this excellent cooling fluid provides dependable heat transfer performance during varying congested urban riding, prolonged high-speed operation and demanding sports riding conditions.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Developed for water-cooled motorcycles, sports motorcycles, touring motorcycles, ATVs and other powersports vehicles equipped with compatible aluminium or mixed-metal cooling systems. products.name: PRINCE® MAXX COOL FACTORY −37°C BLUE
description: PRINCE® MAXX COOL FACTORY −37°C BLUE is an advanced, prediluted, ready-to-use motorcycle coolant formulated with leading-edge Phosphated Organic Acid Technology (P-OAT) to address the stringent cooling system requirements of modern Japanese motorcycles. Its specialized phosphate-enhanced inhibitor system combines rapid aluminium surface passivation with long-lasting organic acid corrosion protection, safeguarding radiators, cylinder heads, water pumps and intricate coolant passages. The silicate-free, nitrite-free, borate-free and amine-free formulation helps minimize harmful deposit formation and abrasive wear of water pump seals, ensuring consistent thermal transfer efficiency, excellent oxidation stability and prolonged cooling system durability.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Developed for modern water-cooled motorcycles, sports motorcycles, superbikes and other powersports vehicles requiring silicate-free, phosphate-enhanced ethylene glycol-based antifreeze coolants. Particularly suited for Japanese motorcycles from Honda, Yamaha, Suzuki, Kawasaki, etc., where compatible phosphated organic technology coolants are highly recommended by the manufacturer.

products.name: PRINCE® MAXX CHAIN LUBE
description: PRINCE® MAXX CHAIN LUBE is a high-performance synthetic motorcycle chain lubricant engineered with advanced penetration and high-adhesion technology to withstand demanding drivetrain operating conditions. Its specialized formulation penetrates chain link assemblies and forms a tenacious lubricating film with excellent resistance to centrifugal fling-off and water wash-off. Advanced anti-wear and extreme-pressure additives minimize friction and progressive wear between chain rollers and sprockets, while effective corrosion inhibitors safeguard metallic surfaces against rust and oxidation, promoting smoother power transmission and prolonged drivetrain service life.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Developed for conventional non-sealed, O-Ring, X-Ring and Z-Ring motorcycle drive chains. Particularly suitable for everyday riding, prolonged high-speed operation and demanding all-weather riding conditions.
